library(gt)
```

```{r}
round(3.14159)
round(3.14159, digits= 2)
```
Argument order

print(rep(5, 7))
print(rep(x = 5, times = 7))
```
Answer to Exercise - Assigning values to variables: 5
```
Character, numerical and logical variables
```
```{r}
character <- "abcdef"
number <- 12
logical <- TRUE
print(paste(character, number, logical))
print(class(character))
print(class(number))
print(class(logical))
```
Using variables of different types
```
```{r}
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123

num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543

```
Vectors
```{r}
cell_ID <- c(cell_ID_1, cell_ID_2)
treated <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
num_cells_before <- c(num_cells_before_1, num_cells_before_2)
num_cells_after <- c(num_cells_after_1, num_cells_after_2)
```
Indexing
```
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
my_fourth_pet <- all_my_pets[4]
print(my_fourth_pet)
```
Creating a data frame

```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)


print(my_data_frame)
```
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```

```{r}
radiation_data_frame <- tibble(
  cell_ID = c("CX1", "CX2"),
  treated = c("TRUE", "FALSE"),
  num_cells_before = c(5415, 8123),
  num_cells_after = c(1432, 7543)
)

gt(radiation_data_frame)
```
